items.title: Caleb and Joshua
items.charge: Wholly following the Lord when ten spies and the whole congregation would not

items.title: Daniel
items.charge: Purposing in his heart not to defile himself with the king's meat; praying three times a day with his windows open toward Jerusalem, decree or no decree

items.title: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian
items.charge: Going to the king for Jeremiah, and drawing him up out of the dungeon with old cast clouts and rotten rags

items.title: Eleazar the scribe
items.charge: Choosing to die gloriously rather than eat swine's flesh, or pretend to, at ninety years old

items.title: Gideon
items.charge: Throwing down the altar of Baal in his father's house; going against Midian with three hundred, as the Lord said

items.title: Jael
items.charge: Blessed above women in the tent: the nail, the hammer, and Sisera

items.title: Jehoiada the priest
items.charge: Hiding the king's son six years from Athaliah; making a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people; doing good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house

items.title: Judith
items.charge: A widow who feared God greatly, fasting all the days of her widowhood; going out to Holofernes in the name of the Lord

items.title: Mattathias
items.charge: Zealous for the law: refusing the king's commandment at Modin, and executing the apostate on the altar as Phinehas did Zambri

items.title: Mordecai and Esther
items.charge: Mordecai: bowing not to Haman. Esther: going in to the king against the law, after three days' fast: if I perish, I perish

items.title: Nehemiah
items.charge: Building the wall in fifty-two days with a sword in one hand; taking no governor's bread; forbidding usury; shutting the gates on the Sabbath; remember me, O my God, for good

items.title: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
items.charge: Refusing to fall down and worship the golden image; not careful to answer the king in this matter

items.title: Shiphrah and Puah, the midwives
items.charge: Fearing God and not doing as the king of Egypt commanded them

items.title: Stephen
items.charge: Full of faith and of the Holy Ghost; a face like an angel before the council; forgiving those who stoned him

items.title: The seven brethren and their mother
items.charge: Refusing to taste swine's flesh under torture, seven times over, in hope of the resurrection
